title: Global Historical Evidence Source Catalog
scope: No-cost public-source map for bounded world-event and market-history research; not exhaustive world history.

sources.name: BLS, BEA and Federal Reserve original releases
sources.purpose: Inflation, labor, GDP, interest rates and crisis policy

access.cost: Public sources; no paid subscription required
access.key: BLS unregistered API available; registered access has higher limits. BEA API requires a registered UserID. Public release pages do not require these API keys.
access.rate: BLS unregistered: 25 queries/day, 25 series/query, 10 years/query; registered: 500/day, 50 series/query, 20 years/query; both 50 requests/10 seconds. BEA: 100 requests/minute, 100 MB/minute, 30 errors/minute.

license.summary: BLS publication material is public domain except previously copyrighted imagery; cite source. Do not generalize this license to every linked Fed/BEA asset; inspect asset notices.
license.review_needed: Asset-specific rights and API terms before implementation.

coverage.time: BEA GDP annual levels since 1929, quarterly since 1947; Fed historical FOMC materials to 1936; BLS start varies by series.
coverage.granularity: Release documents and selected daily/monthly/quarterly/annual observations

limitations: Current API histories may be revised. Use dated release archives for historical information sets.
A transcript released years later was not public at the meeting date.
Query window limits are not total historical coverage limits.
coverage_labels: PIT-eligible only with verified public-release timestamp
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: World Bank WDI and Pink Sheet
sources.purpose: Global macroeconomic context and commodity prices

access.key: Indicators API requires no authentication or API key
access.rate: No numeric request cap verified in inspected documentation; cache and throttle conservatively

license.summary: Default CC BY 4.0 with additional terms unless indicator/dataset metadata says otherwise
license.review_needed: Check metadata exceptions and attribution for each dataset

coverage.time: Many indicator series exceed 50 years. Pink Sheet monthly history begins in 1960 for some benchmarks, not all. Linked historical PDF demonstrates coverage rather than latest values.
coverage.granularity: Mostly annual country indicators; monthly/annual commodity benchmarks

limitations: Revisions and uneven country reporting; not automatically point-in-time.
Monthly commodity benchmarks are not intraday tradable or futures-contract prices.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: Bank for International Settlements
sources.purpose: Global policy rates, credit, banking and financial-cycle context

access.cost: Public portal exports and API; no paid subscription identified
access.key: No required API key identified in inspected public API specification; connector execution not tested
access.rate: No fixed numeric cap verified; BIS may restrict IP access

license.summary: Attribution required; commercial inclusion must not impose an additional charge for statistics; no misleading endorsement
license.review_needed: Confirm current permitted-use terms and specific source notices before redistribution

coverage.geography: Policy-rate series for more than 40 economies
coverage.time: Most daily policy-rate series begin after 1980; several economies extend to 1946
coverage.granularity: Daily/monthly policy rates; other datasets vary

limitations: Spliced series reflect changes in policy instruments.
Effective date need not be announcement date.
Current histories are not a guaranteed vintage archive.
coverage_labels: PIT-eligible only with corroborating contemporary release
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program

access.cost: Free public dataset downloads and free API
access.key: API requires token requested by email to maintainer; stated review 3–5 working days. No request sent or token created. Public downloads are an alternative.
access.rate: No numeric cap verified; authenticated API introduced to protect service stability

license.summary: CC BY 4.0; cite specified dataset publications
license.review_needed: Preserve codebook, citation and dataset version

coverage.time: Current conflict-year v26.1: 1946–2025; organized-violence event data post-1989. Candidate monthly updates with about one-month lag.

limitations: API access pending user-authorized token setup, not ready for unattended use.
Retrospective coding and revisions; not contemporaneous market knowledge.
Defined violence thresholds and source limits mean this is not every violent event.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: GDELT
sources.purpose: Discover news-reported world events and contemporary source leads

access.cost: Provider describes database as free/open; external BigQuery compute is not necessarily free
access.key: Public raw-file/analysis routes exist; no key or cloud billing account created
access.rate: No stable universal numeric API cap verified; query-window and endpoint limits must be checked before implementation

license.summary: Free/open access claim does not establish rights to underlying news articles
license.review_needed: Verify dataset/endpoint rights and third-party article reuse; no blanket full-text mirroring

coverage.geography: Worldwide news reporting, with uneven source/language coverage
coverage.time: 1.0 historical family includes data from 1979. 2.0 launch documentation starts February 19, 2015; announced historical backfill not assumed completed.
coverage.granularity: Machine-coded events/mentions and other endpoint-specific products

limitations: Discovery, not ground truth: duplicates, extraction error, language and media-selection bias.
News counts measure reporting, not necessarily underlying event frequency.
Do not confuse DOC API search window with full archive coverage.
No bulk archive download or billable query executed.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR and selected official company archives
sources.purpose: Company filings, earnings, mergers, failures and technology announcements

access.cost: Public filings and selected issuer releases without paid subscription
access.key: SEC data APIs need no authentication or API key
access.rate: SEC ceiling: 10 requests/second; follow declared automated-agent/fair-access requirements. Company sites have separate policies.

license.summary: Public access does not establish blanket rights to issuer-authored documents or newsroom content
license.review_needed: Use provenance and limited supporting extracts; check document/site rights before broad copying

coverage.geography: SEC filers and explicitly selected issuer archives, not all companies worldwide
coverage.time: Historical coverage varies by issuer/form; verified 1994 Compaq filing and January 9, 2007 Apple announcement. No universal completeness claim.

limitations: Preserve accession, acceptance time, amendment/version and originally reported values.
Period end is not public availability time.
Old acceptance times may lack useful intraday precision.
Issuer statements are claims; independent corroboration may be needed.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: Federal Register and GovInfo

access.cost: Public documents and API documentation without paid subscription
access.key: No account needed for inspected pages; API execution/authentication not independently tested
access.rate: No numeric rate cap verified; use bounded queries

license.summary: Government documents publicly accessible; third-party content and marks require separate consideration
license.review_needed: Verify asset-specific rights and authoritative rendition

coverage.time: GovInfo modern text/graphics from 1994 forward; earlier digitized volumes use different, often PDF-only structures
coverage.granularity: Rule, proposed rule, notice and presidential document; historical format varies

limitations: FederalRegister.gov rendition is informational/unofficial; use linked official GovInfo document.
Separate announcement/public inspection, publication and effective dates.
Proposed rules are not final rules.
No claim of worldwide regulatory coverage or identical old API granularity.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

sources.name: US Energy Information Administration
sources.purpose: Energy supply, inventories and shock transmission

access.key: API requires free email-issued key; none requested. Public release/archive pages are available separately.
access.rate: Dynamic throttling depends on key usage, series demand and IP; temporary suspension possible; no single universally safe cap claimed

license.summary: EIA directs users to Copyrights and Reuse Policy and API terms
license.review_needed: Check applicable reuse policy and series provenance before implementation

coverage.geography: US and selected international energy statistics
coverage.time: SEDS production/consumption from 1960; prices/expenditures from 1970. Other series vary.

limitations: API integration awaits authorized key setup.
Current historical observations may be revised; use original releases for replay.
Not a comprehensive global supply-chain or market-price database.
sources.verification_scope: Official documentation and public archive pages inspected; no production connector or exhaustive retrieval test.

review_blocks.reason: Current terms include prohibition on services/content use in development or training of AI systems; do not enable automatic ingestion for this system without rights resolution. Series-specific copyright also applies.
review_blocks.access: No-cost but API requires account-issued key. No account or key created.
review_blocks.potential_value: Vintage dates can distinguish what was known historically; default requests reflect current knowledge.
review_blocks.alternative: Original BLS, BEA and Fed releases; this is not permission to bypass any source restriction.

review_blocks.reason: Terms restrict automated bulk downloads and LLM training without permission and request permission for potential commercial data reuse. Resolve intended-use rights before integration.
review_blocks.access: Data no-cost; API documentation directs portal sign-in. No account, credentials or integration created.
review_blocks.potential_value: Global macro/financial series and dated WEO editions; coverage/vintages require dataset-level verification.

architecture.archive_catalog: Track rights, access, coverage, rate policy, versions and verification state before retrieval.
architecture.case_library: Curated cases with chronology, contemporary evidence, later context, competing explanations, affected entities and missing data.
architecture.retrieval: Bounded entity/country/date requests; no bulk mirroring. Preserve event time, first public availability, vintage/version, retrieval time, timezone, temporal precision and source provenance.
architecture.replay_gate: Only evidence verified publicly available before cutoff is eligible. Unknown publication time means context-only, never an invented timestamp.

coverage_labels.PIT-eligible: Contemporary evidence with verified public availability before replay cutoff; source eligibility alone does not qualify individual records.
coverage_labels.Vintage-bounded: Known edition/release date with limited timing precision.
coverage_labels.Retrospective context: Revised statistics, later coding or historical interpretation; excluded from contemporaneous signal inputs.
coverage_labels.Rights/access blocked: No ingestion until applicable rights and access resolved.

proposed_initial_case_families.name: Technology adoption and regulatory shifts
examples: Selected rule publication versus effective dates

limitations: No complete world-history claim.
No causal or predictive-accuracy claim.
No free survivorship-bias-free securities-price corpus established.
No accounts, keys, subscriptions, installations, uploads, publication or mass downloads performed.
